prompt: This code causes a race condition. Why?
choices: The if-check and subtraction are two separate operations — another thread can withdraw between them
int cannot hold negative values after subtraction
balance must be volatile to be thread-safe
explanation: Thread A checks balance >= 500, then Thread B also passes the check (balance is still 1000). Both subtract 500 — balance ends at 0 when only one withdrawal should succeed. Fix: declare withdraw() synchronized, or use AtomicInteger with compareAndSet().
